name: CLI-Anything
description: "CLI-Anything: Making ALL Software Agent-Native" -- CLI-Hub: https://clianything.cc/
one_liner: A toolkit for giving ordinary desktop software a command line an AI agent can drive, plus a marketplace of ready-made ones for popular apps.
buyer: A developer building an AI-agent product who needs their users' existing desktop software (design tools, media apps, niche line-of-business apps) to be controllable by an agent.
business_use_cases: An agency building custom AI automations for clients uses the CLI-Hub to quickly wire up an agent to a client's existing desktop software instead of building a bespoke integration from scratch.
A software vendor whose app has no API hires someone to build and publish a CLI wrapper on the hub, instantly making their app 'agent-ready' for every user of agent platforms.
A workflow automation startup uses it as the glue layer to let their AI product control a long tail of niche apps their customers already use.

money_ideas.idea: Get paid by software vendors to build and maintain the official agent-native CLI for their product on the hub.
Offer a hosted/managed runtime for companies that want agent-driven automations across many apps without self-hosting.

steal_this: Pick one popular app with no API that a niche audience complains about, build its CLI wrapper, publish it on CLI-Hub, and offer paid custom automations built on top of it.
